name: onedrive
description: Search, create, edit, share, and recover personal OneDrive files with preview-and-confirm safeguards.

interface.shortDescription: Search, edit, share, and recover personal OneDrive files safely.
interface.longDescription: Use personal Microsoft OneDrive in ChatGPT Work to search and open files; create folders; upload, update, rename, copy, and move content; inspect and edit Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files; export PDF or text; manage links and permissions; and recover recycle-bin deletions. Consequential writes and sharing actions use preview-and-confirm safeguards plus post-action verification. Every user signs in with OAuth, and credentials and caches stay isolated by account.
defaultPrompt: Run a OneDrive plugin health check.
Inspect and safely edit a Word, Excel, or PowerPoint file in OneDrive.
